findings.title: Bruceton Ambulance Service suspends operations in Preston County
findings.publisher: WBOY (Nexstar Media; full story syndicated by AOL)
findings.exact_supporting_passage: Bruceton suspended operations as of Oct. 27 and said it is switching insurance carriers.
findings.access_consequences: Preston County has one fewer operating ambulance service and one fewer available truck, per the county EMS ordinance administrator. The impact on response times, substitution and restoration date is unknown.
findings.affected_population: Preston County residents who would otherwise rely on Bruceton Community Ambulance Service; number of patients or calls affected not reported.
findings.temporal_note: Late-discovered access loss, effective October 27 and published November 2 (before current hourly window); not a November 3 operational change. Requires production deduplication.
